    Prayer is better than sleep. Your alarm now knows it: it rings at your exact Fajr time and stops only when a photo proves you're up. A streak that's hard to fake.

Prayer is better than sleep. Your alarm should know that.

Bedless Fajr rings at your exact Fajr time and does not stop until you prove
you are out of bed. Not a reminder. Not a notification you swipe away.

---

IT RINGS AT FAJR. TODAY'S FAJR, WHERE YOU ARE.

Your Fajr time moves every single day, and it is not the same in London,
Dakar or Toronto. Bedless Fajr computes it for your exact location and
updates it daily. Nine calculation angles, Muslim World League by default
for those who do not know theirs. No location? Pick your city from the list.

NO SNOOZE. AND NO PENALTY WHEN THE NETWORK FAILS.

There is no snooze button and no dismiss. The alarm ends when you photograph
the mission target and it checks out. A photo of your ceiling taken from
under the blanket does not pass, and you find that out at 5 AM, which is
exactly the point.

If the check fails twice, bad light, no signal at 5 AM, our server having a
bad day, we let you through rather than punish you for something that is
not your fault. But that morning is marked unverified, and it stays that way.

Your record shows two numbers: days, and days verified.
Anyone can build a streak. Only one of those numbers is hard to fake.

IT RINGS THROUGH SILENT MODE. THE ADHAN APPS DON'T.

Prayer apps play the adhan as a notification. Put your phone on silent and it
says nothing. Bedless Fajr uses a system alarm: it rings through the silent
switch, and it survives a reboot. Then the app takes over and plays the adhan
in full, because Apple caps an alert sound at 30 seconds.

The Fajr adhan by default. Other tones if you prefer, or load your own file.

EXCUSED DAYS, FOR WOMEN.

Women are excused from prayer during their period. Tap Excused: the alarm
stays off for those days, and your streak is kept, not broken. Set how many
days it lasts, or end it early with one tap.

A STREAK YOU WILL NOT WANT TO BREAK

Every morning is a clear win or a clear loss. No late entries, no excuses.
Your current streak and your all-time record stay on screen, together, even
while you are chasing it.

YOUR DAYS, YOUR CHOICE

Nobody wakes at Fajr seven days out of seven forever. Choose the days that
are yours. And when you switch it off, it is genuinely off.

---

WHAT YOU GET
- Fajr time computed for your exact location, updated every day
- 9 calculation angles, Muslim World League by default
- A system alarm that rings through silent mode and survives a reboot
- The Fajr adhan by default, other tones, or your own file
- A photo mission that gets verified
- Streak, all-time record and full history
- Day-of-week control, and a real off switch

---

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Bedless Fajr requires a subscription to unlock the app.

- Yearly: $34.99 per year, which is less than $3 per month.
  Starts with a 7-day free trial.
- Weekly: $4.99 per week. No free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your
subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you turn off
auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can
manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time in your Apple
Account settings.

If you start the free trial, any unused part of it is forfeited when you buy
a subscription.
